verdict.rationale: Notion is a workspace and knowledge-management platform, not a coding agent or source-control tool, so signing AI-authored git commits with SSH or GPG keys falls outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Notion's agents creating git commits. The GitHub integration syncs workflows; it does not author or sign commits.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
